name: Molecular Bioengineering for Human Health
description: To provide key integrated concepts in drug delivery, clinical microbiology and human health. Students will also learn about the latest advances, with focus on the gut-brain-microbiome axis, and their impact on human health. Broad topics: systems approach to physiology, membrane transport theory, understanding biological barriers in drug delivery - for example, microrobots for drug delivery, human gut microbiome, food-microbiota relationships, introduction to omics and data-in-a-vial (industry-oriented module).
